Quinceañera Invitation Ideas: Wording, Themes and Tips

September 20, 2026 · 5 min read

A quinceañera invitation should feel as special as the celebration. Here are ideas for wording, colors and details.

Wording in English

With the blessing of God and our parents, we invite you to celebrate the quinceañera of Valentina.

Wording in Spanish

Con la bendición de Dios y de mis padres, te invito a celebrar mis quince años.

Popular themes

  • Royal and regal in gold and navy
  • Enchanted garden with soft florals
  • Under the stars in midnight blue
  • Blush and rose gold

What to include

  • Ceremony time and church address
  • Reception time and venue
  • Dress code
  • RSVP and reply-by date

A digital invitation lets you share both the ceremony and reception details in one place, in English and Spanish, and update them if plans change.
